persons.name: André Simoneton
persons.key_contribution: Extended the Bovis scale into food radiations (radiovitality); four food categories by wavelength; Bovis → Simoneton → Merz lineage
persons.notes: Trained under Captain Ferrié (French military T.S.F.). Author of 'Radiations des aliments'. The angstrom values are dowser encodings, not spectroscopy.

persons.name: Blanche Merz
persons.key_contribution: Cosmo-telluric high places doctrine; three-dimension biometer scale (physical/etheric/mental); 1979 Chardonne institute; completed Bovis → Simoneton → Merz lineage
persons.notes: First woman in Vaud Grand Council. Learned dowsing from Mauritanian sourciers. Traveled world measuring sacred sites. Bovis family burned his papers before she could examine them.

persons.name: Enel (Prince Michel Vladimirovich Skariatine)
persons.key_contribution: EIFS (Emergence Influence Forms) research; sacred geometry of hieroglyphs; therapeutic radiesthesia; Multiple Wave Oscillator experiments
persons.notes: Romanov-related prince, Chevaliers-Gardes commander. Initiated in Egypt. Founded internal initiatory college in Russia. Published classics of occultism. Influenced Fondation Ark'all (Ravatin, Thieux).
